name: starlight-department-lab
description: Practice human judgment, agentic systems and scientific inference with portable mission records; design departments and test workflow evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Maximize useful intelligence. Prove the outcome.
interface.longDescription: Work through four versioned missions across three schools. Preserve a first attempt, assistance, critique, revision and transfer in portable JSON. Design accountable departments and run synthetic acceptance checks. Practice grants no credentials or authority.
defaultPrompt: Apply maximum useful intelligence to this workflow and design the highest-performing accountable AI department for its explicit outcome.
Use learn-starlight-mission to open Mission Studio. Let me choose a mission, preserve my first attempt before help, and create a portable practice record.
Independently verify this AI department packet before I install or test it.
